# Emily Paige & Co.

> Residential real estate in greater Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Emily Walczak is the founder, a Realtor at Keller Williams Realty Milwaukee Southwest serving buyers and sellers across the four-county Milwaukee metro (Milwaukee, Waukesha, Ozaukee, Washington). Best fit for first-time buyers, sellers preparing to list, downsizers, and anyone moving to Milwaukee who wants a warm, high-touch, no-pressure guide.

## About Emily

Emily Walczak is a Milwaukee-based Realtor and founder of Emily Paige & Co., a residential real estate team operating under Keller Williams Realty Milwaukee Southwest. She holds Wisconsin real estate license #95426-94 and has been in real estate since 2021. A graduate of the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee (UWM), Emily previously ran Silver Springs Auction House, where she developed her instinct for helping people navigate transitions involving property, memory, and value.

Emily is a third-generation entrepreneur, ranked the #1 agent at Keller Williams Realty Milwaukee Southwest. She lives in Bay View with her two pets and writes "mke diaries," a Milwaukee-focused Instagram video series about the city with 20,000+ followers. Her professional focus is quieting the noise of the transaction: simplifying the process, being a steady presence, and giving clients honest opinions on property, price, and offer strategy.

## Services

- Residential home purchases for buyers, including first-time buyers
- Home sales and listing preparation for sellers
- Guidance through life-transition moves: first purchases, growing families, downsizes, estates, and out-of-state relocations to Milwaukee
- Neighborhood-first search for buyers new to Milwaukee
- Full team support through Emily Paige & Co. at Keller Williams

## Best-fit clients

- First-time home buyers in the Milwaukee metro (Emily has closed many and has a network of lenders, inspectors, and insurance agents she introduces clients to)
- Sellers who want a strategic, honest read on pricing and prep, and who value speed and clean execution over a hard-sell
- Buyers relocating to Milwaukee from another city who need neighborhood-level guidance
- Downsizers and empty-nesters moving from a family home into a right-sized property
- Estate sales and inherited-property sales, drawing on Emily's auction-house background

## Service Area

Greater Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Four-county metro (Milwaukee, Waukesha, Ozaukee, Washington) plus surrounding southeast Wisconsin. Neighborhoods and municipalities Emily works in most:

## How to work with Emily

Prospective clients start with a short questionnaire (buyer or seller) linked from the homepage at https://emilypaigeandco.com/#start. Emily reviews the questionnaire before an initial consultation call, so every first conversation is grounded in the client's actual situation, timeline, and price range.

Not ready to commit? Emily offers two free resources anyone can download without a phone call:

- Free 12-Month to Homeownership Guide: https://emilywalczak.myflodesk.com/ebrsw6diwj
- Free local guide (for anyone moving to Milwaukee): https://emilywalczak.myflodesk.com/g89xageera

## Reputation

Emily has a 5.0 rating on Realtor.com with 70+ verified reviews from buyers, sellers, and industry professionals in the Milwaukee real estate community, including from a real estate attorney who describes her as smart, diligent, and genuinely caring about client needs. Clients consistently note her thoroughness during showings (checking foundations, roofs, appliance ages), her responsive communication, her professional network (lenders, inspectors, insurance), and her ability to guide first-time buyers through Milwaukee's competitive market.
